task.description: WF-04, step 1b, gate pass 1 of 3 — CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR checks the interface description docs/design/V1-public-look.md (GUI-DESIGN-ANALYST, step 03 of this run) against the approved v3 sample docs/design/samples/picker-v3-approved-2026-10-26/ (README.md, index.html, styles.css, app.js, office.js, data.js and every snapshot in shots/), the quality bar, the WF-04 step 1b rules of the role file, the program files (docs/program/public-v1/PLAN.md M1 with «Owner sees», the requirements and task M1.4; §4.1 the PUBLIC LOOK lane row; gate rows G8, G9, G21, G22; ARCHITECTURE.md §2, §2.1, §2.2, §11.4, §11.6, §11.7, §14, §17, §18, §19), decisions 0065, 0074 (item 6, the word ban), 0080, 0083, 0084, 0097, 0099, 0116, 0118 (О3 and О1: the browser-test tool of app/ from R1.2), 0122, and the blocks REQ-111 and REQ-112 as written in step 01 (their gate 02 has not run). The text is read in the tree, not the author's summary; every fact it states that the gate builds on is re-checked with the validator's own commands, the sample files and snapshots are opened by the validator. In particular: a side-by-side comparison with the snapshots and styles.css (the owner wants the approved mockup matched one to one, no blended redesign); every page (landing with the stage scene, how it works, examples, the demo survey and its result, 404) at 1470×784, 390×844 and 320×568 in both themes is described; the contrast ratios are computed correctly (at least six recomputed); the not-carried-over list of ARCH §11.7 is complete with the sample places; nothing needs an inline style= or innerHTML; the four desk names «Принято», «Готовим документацию», «Готовим спецификацию», «Готово к просмотру» and the caption «Картинка показывает этапы работы, а не движения людей.» are exact. PASS only when no finding of severity high or medium remains; every finding has its place, the problem with evidence and a concrete fix; Low findings may stand with a PASS when they change no outcome, and say where they go. The owner's words for this run, verbatim: 2026-11-17 (decisions/0115) «Продолжи работу, так чтобы я получил готовый продукт» and «Публичный сайт V1 (Recommended)»; 2026-11-17 (PROGRESS.md, gate row «M1.1 narrowing») «Сначала каркас (Recommended)»; 2026-10-28 (G18) «Да, новые по-английски (Рекомендую)»; 2026-11-18 – 19 (docs/owner-requests/2026-10-27-public-launch-plan.md, the appended section) «пуш, брат. Я хочу чтобы ты меня понял в корне и дал мне результат. Исходя нашей переписки и в целом» and «Да, сайт по ссылке (Recommended)» with its option text. Owner gates in force: G8 not asked (default «б»: the order-related landing texts are built and checked locally only, no prices, sales or ads, noindex, the test-mode banner); G9 not asked (kk hidden on production); G21 (a look release reaches production only after the owner's «похоже» on the page itself); decision 0083 item 7 (public pages never show agent events); nothing a visitor types or taps is stored («Без ... данных»). Next free numbers: REQ-111, REQ-112, decision 0123, AP-164, ISS-0124. The tools check has two expected red tests (CI-3 and CI-8 of tools/test/repo.test.js, open run ISS-0092-20261117-01); they are not fixed here. Read only: the validator changes no file of the project but this handoff (status, completed_at, result); work only inside the Sai folder and the session scratch folder; no git checkout, reset, stash, clean, commit, push or tag, in the project or in any copy. summary: Verdict FAIL: one High and six Medium findings block (F1–F7); five Low findings (F8–F12) do not block and go to the rework of the description. The description is a careful, mostly exact transcription of the sample: every number I re-measured on the sample and every contrast value it prints came out the same; what fails is a contrast pair it does not list, two touch targets, two required page contents it does not place, unexplained changes of the scene light, unnamed derived scene colours, and the phone view of the scene.

Item 1 of WF-04 step 1b (sample side, every visible part described or marked «не переносится» with a reason): read index.html, styles.css (all 352 lines), app.js, office.js, data.js (palettes, staff, questions, texts) and the README; viewed all 8 snapshots. The inventory S1–S69 covers every part I found (shell, start, question, result, «Мой запрос», board, scene, data). Gaps of reason: the light of the question states and the per-desk clip (F5), the team row layout (F8, S18 does not name it), the scene accent and the dropped CSS transitions (F9). The ARCH §11.7 table (section 4) has all 14 items; its sample places are complete: grep of the sample finds innerHTML exactly at app.js:86, 98, 175, 202, 261, 312, 328, 333, 355 and office.js:449, outerHTML at app.js:240, style= at app.js:152 and the property writes at app.js:71-75, 110-111, 168 and office.js:397-415, 443-444, 484-485, 516; localStorage keys at app.js:24-32, 81, 288-306, 329, 380, 383; Math.random at app.js:298; wa.me at app.js:303, 370.

Item 2 (requirement side): §14 maps REQ-111 c1–c16 and REQ-112 c1–c10. Not covered: REQ-111 c1's text «Sai — закрытое тестирование» in index.html (F3); REQ-111 c2/c12's two lists on examples.html (F4); REQ-111 c12's 44×44 for the phone toggle and the brand link (F2); REQ-112 c4's closed colour set (F6); REQ-112 c6's «at 320×568 the canvas fits the width» is not addressed (F7). The rest of the mapping holds when read against the blocks.

Item 3 (states): §11 and 7.18 describe loading, server error, no connection or no answer, refusal, a failed result request, reload, no match, close options, a lot of data, no script and a throwing storage; the empty live strip (7.11) and the canvas failure (9.16) are there. Gaps: the no-script stage height and the colour of the «Вы» line of the fallback row (F12).

Item 4 (values named): tokens, typography, spacing and components match styles.css line by line (I checked every cited line of 6.4, 6.5 and 7.1–7.21). Unnamed: the derived scene colours (F6), the brand link size (F2), the z-order of «Вы» against the plates and the forced break of the two-line plates (F11).

Item 5 (R2 and the bar, no code): nothing on a page comes from agent events (sections 1, 2, 9.9, 9.10, 15); nothing moves but «Вы» after a tap; no field stores anything; the CSP rules of section 5 need no style= attribute and no innerHTML: every dynamic size goes through classes, canvas attributes, scrollLeft or single CSSOM property writes, which style-src 'self' allows (the cited PAGE057 measurement «setAttribute style запрещён (нарушение style-src-attr)» stands in that handoff). The file holds values and rules, no script, rule set or markup to copy.

Task checks. Side by side with the shots and styles.css: matched except F5, F8, F9 (and F7 for the phone framing). Pages × windows × themes: landing, how, examples, demo, 404 at 1470×784, 390×844, 320×568 are described (§8 tables and 8.1–8.5), dark by the token tables; the gaps are F3, F4 and F7. Contrast: all 51 pairs the description prints recomputed by WCAG 2.x, 51 equal to two decimals; the missing pairs fail (F1). ARCH §11.7: complete. Inline style / innerHTML: not needed. The four desk names «Принято», «Готовим документацию», «Готовим спецификацию», «Готово к просмотру» and the caption «Картинка показывает этапы работы, а не движения людей.» are exact (decisions/0084 §3 item 8, ARCH §11.6, REQ-112); the role titles equal the name of project_manager, business_analyst, developer and reviewer in tools/src/team/roles.js (read through an import); the test-mode line and the AI disclosure equal REQ-111.

Text widths in the sample's font stack: plate words at 15.6/900/.03em СПЕЦИФИКАЦИЮ 158.4, ДОКУМЕНТАЦИЮ 152.9, К ПРОСМОТРУ 125.5, 3 · ГОТОВИМ 109.7; caption 374.2 and 349.3; role titles 119.4, 123.8, 109.1, 81.9; the test-mode line 516.1 (13/400) and 481.6 (12/400) against the description's 512.3 and 478.1 (canvas measureText; the line counts are the same).

Owner's words and gates: the quotes of section 1 stand verbatim in decisions/0115, PROGRESS.md and the two owner-request files (checked with the whitespace of the wrapped lines normalised). G8 «б» (order parts local only, section 1 table), G9 (kk hidden on production), G21 (the protected preview), decision 0083 item 7 (no agent events) and «Без … данных» (only sai-lang and sai-theme kept, issue I3 of step 03) are respected.

Mutants (role file pass A.3) do not apply to an interface description: it has no tests and no replacement table; the facts were re-measured instead (self_check). The description's hash is the same before and after the check.

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 4 and the task's contrast check (ARCH §17 «accents 3:1»; REQ-111 c4 «every pair of an accent (the focus ring, the borders of controls …) and its background at least 3:1, in both themes»; c12, c13 on screen)
findings.what: The focus ring is `--acct` everywhere (7.20), and 6.3 lists it only against --bg, --paper and --card. Controls also stand on the cream `--rc`, which stays #fffbf0 in the dark theme: «<enough…>» in the live strip (wide and phone bar), the toggle and «<close>» of the phone sheet, and the link of the example card. Dark `--acct` #ffb06b on #fffbf0 computes 1.740:1 (light #9a4306 on #fffbf0 6.388:1), so in dark the ring of these controls is below 3:1 against the cream around it. A second unlisted pair: on how.html each step is a <button> whose only edge in the default state is the top bar `--ink2` 40 % (color-mix → #b4b8b2 on --paper 1.851:1 light; #4f6367 on --paper 2.423:1 dark), a control border below 3:1. The theme-contrast test of REQ-111 c4 reads «every pair the look description lists», so neither pair would be tested.
findings.needed: Name the ring colour for controls that stand on `--rc` in both themes with its computed ratio (≥ 3:1 against --rc and against the frame next to it), list every control on --rc, and add these rows to 6.3; for the how.html step buttons either give the default bar a colour of ≥ 3:1 or state which edge is the control's boundary (the number square's 2px --ink2 edge, 6.39 / 7.77) and that the bar is decoration, and list that pair.

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b items 2 and 4 (REQ-111 c12: every button and every link of the navigation and of the demo at least 44×44)
findings.place: 7.11 (line 528: the toggle «<your answers> ▴» `lnk`, min-height 40; line 530: the bar «72 [C: 8 + 56 + 8]»); 7.2 (line 418: «Brand: a link to `/` [P]»); 6.5 (line 405) and §12 (line 956) «every target ≥ 48×48»
findings.what: The phone toggle is specified at min-height 40 (styles.css:315; measured on the sample 104.6×40 at 390 and 320), below the 44 of REQ-111 c12 and against the description's own 48 rule. The brand becomes a link to / with no size: in the sample's geometry the brand block is 34 px tall at 1470 (tile 30 + 2·2), 30 at 390 and 20.3 at 320 (tile hidden), so the link is below 44×44. A developer who follows 7.11 and 7.2 gets a red c12.
findings.needed: Give the toggle and the brand link sizes that meet the description's own ≥ 48×48 (at least 44×44), say how the brand link keeps it at ≤ 360 where the tile is hidden, and recompute the phone bar height and the 390 fold numbers of 8.4 with the new toggle height.

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 2 (REQ-111 c1: «index.html holds the text «Sai — закрытое тестирование» (REQ-108 criterion 4)»; the guard row (3) NM-1; the post-deploy check «/ holds «Sai — закрытое тестирование»»)
findings.what: No part of the landing carries the required text: the hero has only placeholders («<landing eyebrow>», «<landing h1>», «<landing pitch>»), the title is «Sai — <tagline>» with the tagline left to REQ-111, and none of the sections §14 names for c1 places it. Today the text is the h1 and the title of app/public/index.html; a landing built from 8.1 can drop it and turn c1, NM-1 and the post-deploy check red.
findings.needed: Name the element(s) of index.html that hold the exact Russian «Sai — закрытое тестирование» (title, a visible element or both), their look, and what happens to them on a language switch, and map c1 to that place in §14.

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 2 (REQ-111 description «examples.html shows what can and cannot be ordered and three example requests»; c2 «examples.html shows those three and those lists»; c12 «examples.html showing the three example requests and the two lists»)
findings.what: examples.html holds h1, pitch, three example cards and the big button only. The two lists of what can and what cannot be ordered are placed on the landing (block D, local) but not on examples.html, where REQ-111 requires them; the e2e step of c12 would be red.
findings.needed: Place the two lists on examples.html (their order among the blocks, the component, the three windows), and map c2 and c12 to it in §14.

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 1 and the task's side-by-side check (the owner wants the approved mockup matched one to one; the description's own rule «Every place where the sample is changed says why», line 19)
findings.place: 9.11 (lines 845-863: «.25 at the others [M … `start` and `result`; P for the others]»; line 852: «A desk's bands are clipped to its own column»), 9.13 table (lines 875-882)
findings.what: Three changes of the approved light, two of them with no reason: (a) during the demo questions the desks other than the asking one stay at L .25, where the sample has 0 (office.js:461, `ask`: `lit = i === S.focus ? 1 : 0`); (b) the demo at load (question 1) has all four desks at .75, where the sample's question 1 has desk 1 at 1 and the others at 0 — REQ-112 forbids change by time, not a different first frame; (c) the bands are clipped to cx ± sp/2, where the sample lets neighbours overlap; the stated reason (a closed alpha list for fillStyle) does not need the clip, since overlaps give a finite set of products. Computed for 1470×784, dark, question 5, floor row y 86: at x 263–268 the sample's dim alpha is .18 and the description's .354 (twice as dark), at x 255 .30 against .354; the lit cone narrows from ±62 to ±38 logical at the bottom.
findings.needed: Keep the sample's light (others 0 on a question, question 1 lit as the sample's, overlapping bands) and list the resulting alpha values, or name each change as a known difference with a reason that holds, for the owner's comparison (WF-04 step 6).

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 4 (values named) and item 2 (REQ-112 c4: every fillStyle is a palette value or a scene constant the design lists; «the test subtracts the palette and the constants and finds no rest»)
findings.place: 6.2 (lines 316-317: «Every fill on the canvas is a scene token, a page token named here, or one of these constants»), 9.4 (line 763), 9.5 (line 775), 9.6 (lines 793-795), 9.8 (lines 827-828)
findings.what: The drawing rules use colours derived at draw time that are neither tokens nor listed constants, and several have no value at all: the chair «with a lighter top and a darker bottom row» (office.js:178, ±.25), the desk top «with a highlight row» (office.js:331, wood-l +.25), the visitor's jacket «lighter top, darker bottom» and the backpack (office.js:213-215, +.2, −.25, −.12, +.1), the door highlight and panel («lightened .25», «darkened .2»); not mentioned at all: the shirt light and dark (office.js:175, +.18 / −.22), the skin shade of neck and chin (−.14), the bell, binder and red-box shades (office.js:107, 149, 346). Several depend on the theme (--acc2, --sc-chair, --btn). The sentence of 6.2 is therefore not true, and the developer must decide where these colours come from.
findings.needed: Name every derived colour per theme as a scene token or a listed constant (with the sample's mix rule and its rounding), or state the rule that view.js derives them into the palette from named factors, so the full colour set of REQ-112 c4 is closed; then make 6.2's sentence true.

findings.pass_item: Task check «every page and window size … described»; WF-04 1b item 2 (PLAN M1 «Owner sees» on phone and laptop: «the stage scene with four desks … and the «Вы» figure»; REQ-112 c6 «at 320×568 the canvas fits the width with no horizontal scroll»)
findings.what: At 390 and 320 the canvas is 700 CSS px wide (Rw 350 at s 2) and the stage shows 195 and 160 logical px of it; the landing has no tap, so its camera stays at 0: at 390×844 the door and desks 1–2 are in view (desk 3 starts at x 200), at 320×568 the door, desk 1 and part of desk 2. Desks 3–4 and their stage words are never visible on the landing on a phone — the owner's own device («ссылка на сайт Sai, которую можно открыть с телефона»). The description does not state the visible range per page and window, and does not say how REQ-112 c6's «the canvas fits the width» is met by a canvas wider than the window.
findings.needed: State the visible range of the scene per page and window at load and after taps; state how c6 is read (the stage, not the canvas, fits the width; the canvas is clipped) and raise the wording to ORCH (issue I2); decide or ask whether the phone landing must show all four desks (PLAN M1), keeping the sample's framing as a named known difference if so decided.

findings.what: The default replaces the sample's row of four cards with 72×78 avatars (shot stock-1470-light-01-start) by a 2×2 grid of row cards with 48×52 avatars; S18 names the word change and the integer scale but not this layout change. A measured option that keeps the row of four exists: the role titles at the sample's sub size 13/400 measure Руководитель 87.8, Проверяющий 91.3, Разработчик 81.1 px, inside the card's 97.3. The height «about 78 per card» ignores the two-line «Руководитель проекта» (≈ 86–88).
findings.needed: In the rework: name the change in S18, list the 1:1-keeping option beside the default for decision 0123, and correct the card height; the chosen form goes to the owner's list of known differences at G21.

findings.what: Two departures that no record requires: the scene accent in light becomes #ce6a1d (rug edges, monitor lines, desk 1's shirt, binders, certificate), though 6.3 says illustration colours carry no meaning and ARCH §11.7 concerns UI accents; and every CSS transition is dropped, including the .08 s press of buttons and cards and the .6 s slide of the question tail (UI feedback, not scene motion).
findings.needed: In the rework: keep the sample's values or give each change its reason and list it among the known differences.

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 4 ([M] marks match their source)
findings.what: Marked [M] but not what the cited lines do: «a «Не знаю» answer half a pip … K counts whole answers» — the sample sums option 1 and «Не знаю» .5, fills floor(sum) pips plus one half pip and shows K = floor(sum) (app.js:48-49, 150, 158); «ArrowLeft (not on a card)» — the sample's rule is not on any button (app.js:397); the theme label widths omit the button's letter-spacing .02em (measured with it: Авто 33.6, Светлая 57.8, Тёмная 52.6, Қараңғы 62.8).
findings.needed: In the rework: state one rule each and mark it [P] where it differs from the sample.

findings.what: (1) «(1200 − 3·10)/4 − 2·--px» gives 284.5, not 292; the steps have no pixel frame, so the column is 292.5. (2) ««Вы» … never covers a plate» holds at rest; at 390×844 the label (stage top 140, 18 px and the pointer) and the plates (top 136, 26 px) share a band, so the label crosses each plate during a walk, as in the sample (shot stock-390-light-05-ask5); the z-order is not stated. (3) «line 1 is the number, « · » and the first word» needs an explicit break: natural wrapping in 46 logical px gives «4 · ГОТОВО К» / «ПРОСМОТРУ».
findings.needed: In the rework: correct the formula, state the z-order of «Вы» against the plates, and say that the plate break is explicit.

findings.what: Not decided: the stage height with no script (5.2(d) sets it by script); the text colour of the «Вы» line under the fallback row (on --sc-wall); how DESIGN-QA sees the chosen palette in dark — the approved snapshots show dark only for the other tenant (agency-1470-dark-*), the chosen «Складеон» night palette is only in data.js. The screen-reader list stands inside the role="img" stage: ARIA 1.2 makes the children of img presentational; Chrome 157 still exposes the list under the image (measured), screen readers may not.
findings.needed: In the rework or the code design: name the no-script height and the line colour, name the dark reference (the sample rendered with ?tenant=stock&theme=dark), and put the list beside the img element or record why inside is safe.
